description: Lift the n=176 fused megakernel's occupancy from 1 to 2 CTAs/SM via a COLUMN-EVICTING WINDOWED layout. n=176 is the one genuinely SM-starved shape: its full-matrix megakernel caches the whole 176x176 FP32 matrix in SMEM (124KB/CTA → only 1 CTA/SM, 0.27 waves/SM, GPU 73% idle), and packing 2 matrices is impossible (248KB > 228KB cap). Instead keep ONE matrix per CTA but DON'T hold all 176 columns resident: process the blocked Householder with only an active window of columns in SMEM (e.g. the current nb-panel + already-factored columns evicted to global), dropping peak SMEM below 114KB so 2 CTAs/SM fit. More co-resident CTAs = latency hiding of n=176's serial barrier chain (40 matrices on 148 SMs, the GPU is idle). The trailing update for evicted columns reads from global. A sibling found the SMEM-drop occupancy lever did NOT help n=1024 (CTA-count-limited there) — but n=176 is DIFFERENT: it IS 1-CTA/SM-limited (124KB), so freeing SMEM genuinely doubles occupancy. FP32. Keep n!=176 as parent (19ebe6249). Measure absolute nsys panel-time + ncu achieved CTAs/SM before/after. No 'stream' substring; all guards CLEAN.

WINDOWED megakernel v1 (nb=16,TBW=16,T=384): one CTA/matrix, only active panel+1 trailing tile in SMEM, rest evicted to global. VALIDATE 22 tests+3 guards CLEAN. n=176 contention-invariant ratio shape1/shape3=0.0936 vs parent 0.0574 (+63%). ncu: SMEM 124KB->26KB, Block-Limit-SMEM 1->5, BUT Waves/SM 0.27->0.14, Duration 558->928us.

Decoupled trailing-tile width TBW from panel NB; TBW=64 (fewer per-tile barriers+global round-trips). VALIDATE CLEAN. ratio 0.0852 vs parent 0.0574 (+48%). ncu: SMEM 67KB, Block-Limit-SMEM 2, Waves/SM 0.14, Duration 853us.

TBW=128 sweep (CLEAN contention, shape3=20501==baseline). n=176 abs 1782.8us vs parent 1176.3us (+51.6%); ratio 0.0870. TBW=128 SMEM ~118KB pushes Block-Limit-SMEM back to 1 -> slightly worse than TBW=64. VALIDATE CLEAN.
threads=256 @ TBW=64 (CLEAN, shape3=20497==baseline). BEST windowed: n=176 abs 1639us vs parent 1176us (+39.4%); ratio 0.0800. Narrower CTA cut barrier-wait+register pressure. VALIDATE CLEAN.
threads=128 @ TBW=64 sweep (contended). ratio 0.1024 WORSE than 256 (only 4 warps for the <=176-row reductions). threads sweep: 128/256/384 -> 0.1024/0.0800/0.0852. VALIDATE CLEAN.

nb=32 panel (contended). ratio 0.1230 WORSE than nb=16 (0.0800): wacc[32]/vr[32] register arrays SPILL to local mem (parent caps micro-panel IB=8 to avoid). nb sweep: 16/32 -> 0.0800/0.1230. VALIDATE CLEAN.

FINAL/settled: nb=16,threads=256,TBW=64 (best windowed config). n=176 ratio shape1/shape3=0.0771 (consistent w/ clean threads=256 0.0800)=+34-39% vs parent 0.0574. n!=176 byte-identical (shapes 0,2-11 match parent). ncu: Block-Limit-SMEM 1->2 (GOAL MET, SMEM 124KB->67KB), BUT Waves/SM 0.27->0.14, Registers 115->Block-Limit-Reg 2, Duration 558->783us. SMEM-drop WORKS but occupancy unfillable @ 40 CTAs<148 SMs (brief-35's n=1024 wall) + blocked-WY adds Gram/T/global-traffic. VALIDATE 22 tests+3 guards CLEAN.

Built and exhaustively swept the brief's COLUMN-EVICTING WINDOWED megakernel for n=176 across 7 validated trials (all 22 tests + offgrid/invariance/diff_correctness guards CLEAN every trial; n!=176 byte-identical to parent 19ebe6249; FP32; no 'stream' substring). New kernel qr_windowed: one CTA/matrix, blocked right-looking Householder holding ONLY the active nb-panel + one TBW-wide trailing tile in SMEM, evicting/reloading the rest of the trailing columns to/from global H per panel. Emits geqrf-exact (H,tau), no V/T workspace tensors.

THE BRIEF'S SMEM GOAL SUCCEEDED, the OCCUPANCY GAIN DID NOT. ncu (clean, contention-immune): Dynamic SMEM 124.16KB->67.0KB(TBW=64)/25.9KB(TBW=16); Block-Limit-Shared-Mem 1->2(TBW=64)/->5(TBW=16) -- exactly the 1->2 the brief asked for. BUT Waves-Per-SM DROPPED 0.27->0.14 and per-launch Duration ROSE 558us->783us(T=256)/853us(T=384). Net: every windowed config is a MEASURED REGRESSION on n=176.

PARENT n=176 (unblocked megakernel, profile-confirmed): contention-invariant shape1(n176)/shape3(n512) ratio 0.0574; clean abs 1176us.
WINDOWED full sweep (ratio, lower=better):
  * TBW {16,64,128}@T384: 0.0936 / 0.0852 / 0.0870 (64 optimal; 128 SMEM~118KB re-pins Block-Limit-SMEM=1)
  * threads {128,256,384}@TBW64: 0.1024 / 0.0800 / 0.0852 (256 optimal; 128 starves the <=176-row reductions of warps)
  * nb {16,32}@T256,TBW64: 0.0800 / 0.1230 (nb=16 optimal; nb=32 SPILLS wacc[32]/vr[32] register arrays to local mem)
BEST windowed = nb=16/threads=256/TBW=64 = ratio ~0.078-0.080 (clean abs 1639us) = +36-39% vs parent. HEAD=70b0967 holds this best config.

WHY (the brief's premise breaks at the LAST arrow, same as the sibling's n=1024 tail-stream brief-35): the causal chain 'drop SMEM -> 2 CTAs/SM -> hide the serial barrier latency' requires 2 CTAs to CO-RESIDE on ONE SM. But n=176 B=40 launches a 40-CTA grid (confirmed: eval.py's _make_data_batch yields a list, each custom_kernel call = one B=40 launch, run back-to-back on the default queue), and 40 CTAs < 148 SMs, so the scheduler spreads them 1-per-SM no matter how high Block-Limit-SMEM is -- raising the per-SM LIMIT cannot raise the per-SM COUNT when CTAs<SMs. (Waves/SM = CTAs/(SMs*blocks_per_SM) literally DROPS when blocks_per_SM rises: 40/(148*1)=0.27 -> 40/(148*2)=0.14.) On top of that the blocked-WY restructure adds per-panel Gram+T-build + global C round-trips the parent's pure-rank-1 SMEM-resident megakernel never pays, lengthening the per-launch critical path. So the eviction overhead + unfillable occupancy outweigh the freed SMEM -- the exact measured-negative case the brief said to report honestly (like n=1024's tail-stream).

OPEN DIRECTIONS the manager may want (all OUTSIDE this brief's single-CTA windowed objective, hence surfaced not pursued):
(1) FORCE 2 CTAs onto one SM -- the ONLY way the windowing's freed SMEM pays. With one-matrix-per-CTA + 40 CTAs the scheduler won't double up. PACK 2 matrices per CTA (warp-groups) so co-residence is structural, NOW affordable because each matrix's windowed footprint is ~33KB (2*33=66KB<228KB, vs 2 full 176x176=248KB which the brief-43 packing attempt found impossible). This FUSES brief-43's pack-K-per-CTA (which regressed on the FULL-matrix megakernel for lack of SMEM) with THIS brief's windowing (which frees the SMEM) -- the synthesis neither brief alone could reach. The windowed kernel + its decoupled-TBW plumbing committed here are the reusable substrate.
(2) The n=176 megakernel is at its per-shape optimum (~559us) and n=176 is only ~3-4% of the 12-shape geomean, so the ceiling here is small regardless -- the big movers remain the n=512 B=640 (5 shapes) and n=1024 B=60 (4 shapes) groups, where occupancy/CTA-count levers have far more geomean leverage.
(3) A cluster-FUSED n=176 megakernel (K=2 CTAs split the 176 rows via DSMEM cross-CTA reductions, no cuBLAS, ~62KB/CTA so 2 fit/SM => 40*2=80 CTAs reach ~0.54 waves) -- this raises CTA COUNT (the real lever) rather than per-SM block limit; brief-32 named it untried. Distinct from this brief's single-CTA framing.
